biography.plain_text: Şeyhmus Tatlıcı is a Turkish heir to a family fortune built largely through property investment. The son of businessman Şeyhmus Tatlıcı and his second wife, Bengi, he inherited wealth after his father's death in 2012. The family's commercial interests extended from Istanbul real estate to construction and chromium mining operations.

long_biography.plain_text:
Şeyhmus Tatlıcı developed a collection of cars while living in Dubai, where he spent much of his time in the early 2010s. His garage included several Cadillac Escalades, a customised Corvette and a red Murat 124, combining contemporary luxury vehicles with an interest in older models.

His inherited business interests also connected him to Şe-Tat Madencilik, the family's chromium mining company. Its shareholders included children from both of his father's marriages. His half-brother Taha directed the group until 2016; by 2023 the mining company's facilities in Bursa and Erzurum were leased to another operator.
